card.name: Supportive care wording in overdose treatment
card.fires_on: Small words like "of" or "the" right after a supportive-care verb or noun (support, maintain, keep, loss) in overdose or emergency treatment text. Also the start of "oxygen" in "oxygenation" in the same setting.

modes.label: Support of the system
modes.description: "of" after support or maintenance in overdose treatment advice about the cardiovascular system.
modes.example: Treatment: There is no specific antidote. Support<< of>> the cardiovascular system is of primary importance.

modes.label: Oxygenation wording
modes.description: The start of "oxygenation" in lists of ventilation and airway measures.

modes.label: The phrase "Keep the patient"
modes.description: Linking words in short emergency instructions, such as keeping the patient's legs raised in shock.
modes.example: Hypotension, Shock : Keep<< the>> patient's legs raised and administer a plasma

card.writes: It leans toward unusual, mostly Chinese or odd word pieces and away from liver and metabolism words, so there is no clear help for the text.
